description: This header file declares functions and includes necessary headers for creating and managing device models, resources, endpoints, and metadata in a device management SDK.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Creates and initializes a device object with specified parameters such as UUID, class, driver name, and descriptor.

methods.name: createDeviceMetadata
methods.description: Creates metadata associated with a device, identified by metadata ID and value.

methods.name: createEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a device endpoint with specified ID, profile, and enabled state.

methods.name: createDeviceResource
methods.description: Creates a resource associated with a device, specifying resource ID, value, type, mode, and caching policy.

methods.name: createDeviceResourceIfAvailable
methods.description: Creates a device resource if available, using initial resource values.

methods.name: createEndpointResource
methods.description: Creates a resource for a specific device endpoint.

methods.name: createEndpointResourceIfAvailable
methods.description: Creates an endpoint resource if available, using initial resource values.
